observations: Reuters reported the 2026-09-23 US session ended lower: S&P 500 -0.75%, Nasdaq -1.13%, and Dow -0.68% as oil and Treasury yields rose.
Reuters reported the PHLX Semiconductor Index down about 1.2% and Nvidia down about 1.5%, weakening the prior AI/semiconductor risk impulse.
A same-session independently verified official VIX closing observation was not obtained in the free evidence path, so the volatility leg remains incomplete.

Reuters reported the US 10-year Treasury yield reaching its highest level since 2007 and the 2-year touching its highest level since 2024 after stronger US activity data revived tightening expectations.

Reuters reported on 2026-09-24 that traders assigned roughly a 70% chance to another Fed rate increase in October, up from about 50% a week earlier, while New York Fed President John Williams said another hike this year could be reasonable.

Official Treasury/FRED evidence was available for nominal yields and recent real-yield history, but a fully current 2026-09-24 real-yield observation was not yet published in the free official path used for this review.

C.engine: Japan/Korea indices and FX, Asian opening
observations: Reuters reported the Nikkei 225 up about 1.3% on 2026-09-24 while broader Asia ex-Japan weakened, showing regional divergence rather than uniform risk-on breadth.
South Korea's cash market was closed for Chuseok, so the absence of a fresh KOSPI print is calendar-driven rather than an evidence-quality failure.
Reuters reported USD/JPY around 157.9, with the yen remaining weak despite a modest daily gain; Japanese government bond yields were also elevated.
Reuters reported the CSI300 down about 1.3% during the 2026-09-24 Asian session; Hong Kong equities were also weaker around the midday interval.
HKAB published 2026-09-24 HIBOR fixings: overnight 2.71667%, 1-week 3.12345%, 1-month 2.95691%, 3-month 3.20429%, 6-month 3.50000%, and 12-month 3.94363%.
A single independently verified post-close bundle covering HSI, HSTECH, CSI300 and CNH was not obtained in the free evidence path, so local-market confirmation remains incomplete.
Southbound-flow evidence is handled separately in engine G and is not inferred from index price or turnover.
Reuters reported oil rising more than 2% on 2026-09-24 as US-Iran diplomacy showed little progress, with Brent around $105.40 and WTI around $93.94 during the European morning.
The oil move reinforced inflation and higher-for-longer rate risk even as diplomatic efforts continued.
A sufficiently current independently verified gold observation was not obtained in the free evidence path, so the full commodity cross-check remains incomplete.

F.engine: policy execution, first-party business information, industry opinion, personal/social sentiment
observations: Reuters reported current US-China policy engagement around the Trump-Xi summit and an extension of the trade truce, providing a constructive policy offset to the tighter global financial backdrop.
Recent first-party/business evidence remained constructive for AI infrastructure, including Alibaba's announced large-model and cloud/data-centre expansion plans earlier in the week.
A broad, verified same-session personal/social-sentiment sample was not available and was not inferred from market prices or turnover.

HKEX remains the preferred authority for Stock Connect daily statistics, but a directly verifiable official 2026-09-24 Southbound net-flow value was not exposed in the free evidence path available at the review timestamp.
The most readily available free secondary flow report at review time referred to the prior 2026-09-23 session, not 2026-09-24, and was therefore not reused as current-session evidence.

No current-session verified source was found that can reliably decompose foreign/local/passive/retail/arbitrage participation. Investor identity is not inferred from turnover, price action, or a single Stock Connect channel.

qualitative_read.directional_summary: The observable cross-market tone is cautious and defensive-leaning rather than cleanly risk-on: overnight US equities and semiconductors fell as Treasury yields rose, Hong Kong/China equities weakened, oil returned above $100, and additional Fed tightening remained a live risk. Japan was a notable positive outlier and the US-China trade-truce extension provided a policy offset, but evidence is not sufficiently complete for a formal position-cap regime decision.
qualitative_read.reason_for_no_regime: The accepted contract states that inherited exposure bands are not fitted/validated and must not be applied from incomplete engines. Engine G is materially incomplete, while A, B, D, E and F retain current-session evidence gaps. A bounded formal regime label and numeric position ceiling are therefore not authorized.
